trust_decision.summary: CR-supplied strings (Flow/Output plugin params, keys, tag/id/label/log_level) are written verbatim into the generated fluent.conf text; the fix decides in the renderer that structural tokens must not contain newlines and that newline-bearing values get quoted+escaped (incl. '#').

landing_point.why: The only place that turns Directive params into 'key value' fluentd lines via indentedf with no escaping; 'Fluentd configuration injection' leads straight to the renderer.

fix_sites.entry_point: same CR route; plugin params from StructToStringMapper and hand-built Params (e.g. pkg/sdk/logging/model/types/router.go:68-103); also public SDK API render.FluentRender.RenderDirectives
new helpers validateFluentToken / escapeFluentValue used by the sites above

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Published fix is confined to pkg/sdk/logging/model/render/fluent.go; the second fluentd-config writer (pkg/resources/fluentd/configsecret.go) is untouched and recorded under O8.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The pkg/resources/fluentd writers take values only from the cluster-scoped Logging / control-namespace FluentdConfig spec (admin-controlled) and the field is annotated as an enum (stdout,null), so a solver can argue tenants cannot reach it and it is already validated.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Single-line values must render unchanged and unquoted (JSON-ish values like labels {"a":"b"}, regexes, values containing '#' or quotes); blanket quoting/escaping of every value would change the config fluentd sees and break existing Flow/Output configs and the existing golden tests.

O6_input_shapes: '#' inside a value that the fix quotes (escaped to block #{} interpolation)
quotes, backslashes, tabs inside a newline-bearing value (escaped)

O7_producer.where: pkg/sdk/logging/model/types/stringmaps.go:50 (StructToStringMapper.StringsMap) via pkg/sdk/logging/model/types/types.go:139 (NewFlatDirective); also hand-built Params in pkg/sdk/logging/model/types/router.go:68-103

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Logging/FluentdConfig spec.fluentd.fluentLogDestination is interpolated with fmt %s into fluentlog.conf, no newline check or escaping; the documented enum marker is lowercase and not emitted into the CRD schema.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Admin-controlled field and Go comment says '+kubebuilder:validation:enum=stdout,null' (pkg/sdk/logging/api/v1beta1/fluentd_types.go:107), but CRD has plain type: string (config/crd/bases/logging.banzaicloud.io_loggings.yaml:5117-5118).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (pkg/resources/fluentd vs pkg/sdk/logging/model/render), different file, separate config file (fluentlog.conf) included by fluent.conf

O8_uncovered_routes.route: input.conf <system>/<source> block rendered with html/template from FluentdSpec strings (logFormat, logLevel, rootDir, ignoreSameLogInterval, ignoreRepeatedLogInterval, metrics.path); html escaping does not touch newlines, so extra directive lines (e.g. @include) can be injected.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Admin-controlled spec; html/template already 'escapes' (<, >, quotes), which looks like a defence; logFormat carries an enum comment (pkg/sdk/logging/api/v1beta1/fluentd_types.go:89-91) that is not in the CRD (config/crd/bases/logging.banzaicloud.io_loggings.yaml:5505-5506).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: second implementation of fluentd config generation in pkg/resources/fluentd/config.go:33-56 + configsecret.go, separate package from the renderer

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Single-line param value that itself starts with a double quote (no newline) is still emitted verbatim; fluentd parses it as a double-quoted string where #{...} is evaluated, so the interpolation the fix guards against for its own quoting remains reachable.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Fix comment frames the threat as newline break-out only and the test 'value without newline is left unquoted' asserts plain values must stay unchanged; a solver can argue a quoted value is the user's own literal.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point; how-type (parser differential between Go renderer and fluentd v1 literal parser)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another fmt-built fragment (e.g. a buffer/log rotate section) from a FluentdSpec string
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same file already builds fluentlog.conf by fmt.Appendf with %s; adding a sibling field the same way is the existing idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new {{ .Field }} line in the <system> template fed from FluentdSpec
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The template grows one optional setting at a time via {{- if .X }} blocks; maintainers add these routinely.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Params value built by joining user-controlled list/map entries that could carry a raw quote prefix
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Hand-built Params bypass the struct mapper and are joined with strings.Join today.

O9_family: CWE-74/CWE-77 config-language injection (newline break-out and Ruby #{} evaluation in generated fluentd config)

O10_build.toolchain: go (module at repo root; version per go.mod, not checked)
O10_build.project_tests: pkg/sdk/logging/model/render/fluent_test.go (golden render tests, pure Go, no cluster); pkg/resources/fluentd has unit tests of its own (not inspected)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape/quote only param values containing newlines in FluentRender at fluent.go:64, leaving the PluginMeta tokens, keys, the quote-prefixed single-line value and the pkg/resources/fluentd templates open.

out_of_scope_notes: record_transformer exposes enable_ruby to tenant Flows (pkg/sdk/logging/model/filter/record_transformer.go:50), which already lets Flow authors evaluate Ruby by design; weakens the threat model.
FlowMatch labels/namespace_labels are joined with ',' and ':' without validation (pkg/sdk/logging/model/types/router.go:84-101): a separator-split differential on routing, not on config injection.
Fluent-bit config is generated by text/template in pkg/resources/fluentbit/configsecret.go:21; a different product and sink, not pursued.
Logging.spec.flowConfigOverride is raw fluentd config by design (controllers/logging/logging_controller.go:424-425).
